name: Aislinn Wishart
original_name: エイスリン・ウィッシュアート
source:
Aislinn is a third-year at Miyamori Girls' High School, [url=/c35871]Shiromi's[/url] classmate and is originally from New Zealand. She isn't very fluent in Japanese so she uses a message board to commmunicate with her teammates instead of talking (though she is shown to know simple words of the language). Aislinn is constantly smiling and even hums while walking towards her match. She was rather devastated thinking she let her team down when she lost her match.

There's nothing flashy nor anything that stands out about her game but according to Shiromi, Aislinn can draw her ideal table like something from a dream. Whenever she plays she always gets a winning hand and in terms of winning percentage she was first in her country. [url=/c35879]Kyouko[/url] explains that Aislinn will always get a closed hand tenpai before the 13th turn.﻿ However, if the other players make unpredictable or sudden movements which break her plan, she has to design her table once more.
